title: The long path
goals: Reach the foot of the rise's steps.
starting_code: # Walk left to the steps in one instruction.
hints: You only need one instruction to walk the whole way.
Put a number inside the brackets to say how far to go.
Use the `move_left` method with the number of steps as its argument.
intro: We want to walk along the foot of the grassy rise. We can go all the way in just one instruction. Tell your move exactly how far to go!
outro: Excellent! Giving an argument to your move is much faster than writing step after step.
learned: Now you know what an argument is, and how to use a move's argument to say how far to go.
